घटास्य: Ghaṭāsya — an Asura in the sabhā of Hiraṇyakaśipu. M. 161. 81.
घटिका: Ghaṭikā — a measurement of time. Bhā. V. 21. 4.
घटोत्कच: Ghaṭotkaca — a son of Bhīmasena by Hiḍimbā (Hi-ḍambā, Haiḍimbī). Bhā. IX. 22. 30-31; M. 50. 54; Vā. 99. 247; Vi. IV. 20. 45.
घटोदर: Ghaṭodara (I) — a member of Śiva gaṇa. Br. III. 41. 27.
Ghaṭodara (II) — a commander of Bhaṇḍa. Br. IV. 21. 88.
Ghaṭodara (III) — an Asura in the sabhā of Hiraṇya-kaśipu. M. 161. 80.
घट्टधर: Ghaṭṭadhara — a region noted for horses. Br. IV. 16. 17.
घण्टेश्वर: Ghaṇṭeśvara — a tīrtham sacred to Pitṛs. M. 22. 70.
घनोदधि: Ghanodadhi — the sea of clouds surrounding the aṇḍa, supported by the ever-blazing energy (fire) of clouds (ghana-tejas) like the burning iron rod; outside is a vast region sup-ported by Ghana vāta, which rests again on ākāśa. The last is supported by mahat, pradhāna being a prop to mahat. Br. II. 21. 24-7; Vā. 49. 153-55; 50. 82-4.
घर्मात्मन्: Gharmātman — a son of Dhṛṣṭa. Vā. 95. 39.
घूर्णिका: Ghūrṇikā — a servant-maid of Devayānī. M. 27. 24-7.
घ्र्णि: Ghrṇi (I) — a son of Vaidya (s.v.). Br. III. 59. 7; Vā. 84. 7.
घृणि: Ghṛṇi (II) — a sage of the XI epoch of Manu. Vi. III. 2. 31.
घृणिन्: Ghṛṇin — in previous birth, son of Marīci and Ūrṇa, now born as a son of Devakī and killed by Kamsā. Kṛṣṇa recovered him from Sutalam, took him to Dvārakā to be seen by his parents. Afterwards he went to heaven. Bhā. X. 85. 47-56.
घृत: Ghṛta — a son of Dharma and father of Durdama. M. 48-8; Vi. IV. 17. 4.
घृतधेनु: Ghṛtadhenu — fit for a gift during the Viśokadvādaśī-vratam. M. 82. 18.
घृतप्राश: Ghṛtaprāśa — taking of ghee, as purification for sin of killing worms in food, oil, fruits and flowers. M. 227. 38.
घृतपृष्ठ: Ghṛtapṛṣṭha — a son of Priyavrata, appointed Lord of Krauñcadvīpa. Bhā. V. 1. 25 and 33; 20. 20.
घृतम्: Ghṛtam — an ocean of, surrounding Krauñcadvīpa. Br. II. 16. 12; IV. 31. 18; M. 13. 7.
घृतव्रतम्: Ghṛtavratam — leads to the world of Brahmā. M. 101. 68.
घृतशैल: Ghṛtaśaila — mountain of ghee, as a gift. M. 83. 6; 89. 1-2.
घृताची: Ghṛtācī — an Apsaras, mother of ten sons through Rau-drāśva; (Bhadrāśva-M. P.); presiding over the month of Tapas;1 in the sun's chariot in the Āśvayuja month;2 with the Śarat Sun.3 1) Bhā. IX. 20. 5; XII. 11. 39; Vi. I. 9. 103; Br. II. 23. 13; Br. III. 7. 15. M. 49. 4; Vā. 69. 49; 70. 68. 2) Vi. II. 10. 11. 3) Br. IV. 33. 19; Vā. 52. 13.
घृताच्युत: Ghṛtācyuta — a R. in Kuśadvīpa. Bhā. V. 20. 15.
घृतार्चि: Ghṛtārci — a sage moving with the sun. Br. II. 21. 115.
घृतायु: Ghṛtāyu — a son of Purūravas and Urvaśī. Br. III. 66. 23.
घृतेयु: Ghṛteyu — one of the ten sons of Raudrāśva. Vā. 99. 124.
घृतोद: Ghṛtoda — sea surrounding the Kuśadvīpa (see Ghṛtam). Bhā. V. 1. 33; 20. 13; Br. II. 19. 63-5; Vi. II. 4. 45.
घोरकोलाहल: Ghorakolāhala — the twelfth and last avatār of Viṣṇu in Varāhakalpa. Vā. 97. 76.
घोष: Ghoṣa (I) — a son of Pulinda and father of Vajramitra; a Śunga king; ruled for three years. Bhā. XII. 1. 17. Br. III. 74. 153.
Ghoṣa (II) — a son of Lambā (Langhā-Vi. P.) and Dharma. Br. III. 3. 33; M. 5. 18; 203. 8. Vā. 66. 33; 80. 31. Vi. I. 15. 107.
Ghoṣa (III) — a small village hamlet. Br. III. 69. 40; 70. 10. Vā. 94. 40.
घोषवसु: Ghoṣavasu — a son of Pulindaka and father of Vajra-mitra. Vi. IV. 24. 35.
घ्राणम्: Ghrāṇam — a Tuṣita god. Br. III. 3. 19.
